entries.test: Public records of LLM releases and availability before May 17, 2024 would establish whether LLM technology had already been made available for use, including by bad actors.
entries.note: The metaphor has a plain factual core in context: LLMs already exist and are available. It specifies no particular harmful consequence.

entries.test: Public demonstrations and independent evaluations of AI systems existing by May 17, 2024 would establish whether any had achieved general intelligence.
entries.note: The contrast with existing LLMs supports reading the metaphor as saying AGI had not yet been achieved. Disagreement over AGI's precise threshold does not alone make this uncheckable.
